contract.body_frame: X long toward board/camera end, Y lateral (+Y = MJCF left_leg side), Z screen normal
contract.acc: accelerationIncludingGravity, m/s^2, reads +Z*9.81 when lying screen-up
contract.action: residual deg = 4*a added to unchanged seed joints before servoTargets
contract.legmap: L=-Y (servo L drives the MJCF joint on that side) -- Brit 0929: servo L (trim -8) is the robot LEFT = MJCF -Y
contract.phase: cycle += (1/25)*hz*dir each tick, from 0 at gait start; seed ramps in over 0.7 s
contract.gyro_missing: numeric zero with availability=0; measured zero has availability=1

train.initializer: fresh zero output head, std exp(-2.5)
train.bench_evidence: seed-only no tip on three carpet trials; old residual made startup/late tipping worse

training.warmStart: frozen seedfirst4 actor+critic with explicit mask-column insertion; fresh optimizer
